_comment: Recipe for bench/make_viewer_data.py manifest. Copy to <served root>/recipe.json; paths are relative to that directory. To show a new run: copy its .falt sections into a new dir, point a pane's dir (and its rate JSON) there and rerun the manifest step. Pane kind falt = Faltwerk stream (old recipes say csgs, still accepted); splq = quantised per-frame splat dumps.
